# SocioGenie

> SocioGenie is AI social media software for growing businesses worldwide. It plans, designs and publishes your Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn posts through the official APIs. Studio from $14.99 a month; AI Manager, which runs your calendar, from $49.99.

## Disambiguation
- SocioGenie is the software product at **sociogenie.ai**: social media software for growing businesses, used worldwide, operated from Ahmedabad, India by MAGNATEX LLP. Launched 28 July 2026.
- It is **not** sociogenie.com, an unrelated lifestyle blog based in Kolkata.
- It is **not** SOCi, Social Genie, Sociamonials or SocioBranding.

## Facts
- Subscription plans (USD, monthly): **Studio $14.99** (seven AI creation tools, 100 credits, you decide what gets made) · **Prime AI $49.99** (AI Manager on 1 platform, 50 credits) · **Elite AI $69.99** (2 platforms, 100 credits) · **Legacy AI $84.99** (3 platforms, 150 credits).
- Every plan generates content with AI and publishes to connected accounts. The difference between plans is who decides what gets posted — the user, or the AI.
- **Human review before publishing applies to Prime, Elite and Legacy only.** On Studio the user creates each post and sees it before it publishes.
- The **Studio plan** ($14.99/month, recurring, 100 credits per month) is a different product from the **Basic credit pack** ($14.99 one-time, 100 credits, expires after 30 days).
- Pricing (USD, monthly): Studio $14.99 (100 credits) · Prime AI $49.99 (50 credits) · Elite AI $69.99 (100 credits) · Legacy AI $84.99 (150 credits).
- Credit packs (one-time, valid 30 days): Starter $6.99/40 credits · Basic $14.99/100 credits · Growth $28.99/200 credits · Business $41.99/300 credits.
- Credit cost per manually-triggered action: Create Post 2 · Marketing Scene 2 · Occasion Post 2 · Campaign 3/day · Product Post 4 (asset) or 6 (full social) · Carousel 3/slide · Video 100.
- AI Plan automation never charges credits — it runs on the subscription itself, generating 19 pieces of content per cycle (5 marketing visuals, 7 automated posts, 3 quick-create, 2 videos, 2 carousels) plus a variable number of seasonal/occasion posts, at no additional credit cost.
- On Prime, Elite and Legacy, Manual Review (you approve each post yourself) is the default; Auto Approve routes it through SocioGenie's own in-house team for brand, caption and technical checks — not a fact-check or legal/compliance review.
- **Marketing visuals** place the business's real product, taken from its own Brand Memory photos, into a photographed advertising scene: Billboard, Transit lightbox (bus shelter, metro, airport, mall), Magazine spread, Storefront window, or Scale stunt. The scene is designed around the exact product. The setting is chosen to fit the business's region, from an Indian metro to a European old town, a modern East Asian city, an American street or Gulf luxury. AI Manager plans five per cycle with the topics shuffled; on any plan they can also be made on demand from Marketing Scenes.
- Publishes via official Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn platform APIs, not unofficial or scraper-based methods. The Meta integration has passed Meta App Review.
- Operated by MAGNATEX LLP (LLPIN ACU-5689), Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Commercially launched 28 July 2026.
- Payments processed by Dodo Payments Inc. (Merchant of Record), billed in USD.
- Last reviewed: 2026-10-06.
